target.label: large TypeScript monorepo, real-time telephony platform with a payment lane, chat-bot operator surface, and infrastructure-as-code

notes: The strict revalidator matched severity words anywhere on the composite severity line, so every finding whose confidence or risk field said high or low read as load-bearing or deflated until severity was moved to its own line. The anchor grammar has no escape for a backtick inside a backtick-delimited anchor. The bundle compiler refused four of ten discovery slices as too broad, and bundling did not reduce per-unit spend at this slice size. The atlas writer's manifest fails the target's formatter. A lead-filed finding collided with a discovery unit's id because nothing mints ids at merge time.
